🎵 A Grammy-winning band just pulled dozens of Nintendo covers off YouTube!

8-Bit Big Band — the video game music cover group behind two Grammy wins — has removed 37 songs from its YouTube channel. Founder Charlie Rosen says some Nintendo covers (Mario, Animal Crossing, Zelda) weren't properly licensed, and the band pulled them "out of respect for Nintendo."

Both of the band's Grammy-winning tracks are among those removed from YouTube, including "Super Mario Praise Break." Their cover "Meta Knight's Revenge" has been pulled from streaming services entirely. Some tracks remain on Spotify and the band's own site for now, and it's unclear when (or if) the rest will return.

🕒 Published: 08:02 GMT+3
📰 Sources: Video Games Chronicle
👥 x.com/Nintendo
